meta.note: The 10,000-entry target was NOT approached: each entry is grounded in measured behaviour, failure-taxonomy counts or an explicit workstream gap. Padding the ledger with artificial entries was rejected.

entries.existing_limitation: LSMR trust-region steps stalled at 96 views (optimality 39 to 27 over 400 evals; dense reached cost 293.5 in 38)
entries.proposed_implementation: exact sparse-LU Levenberg-Marquardt with IRLS weights and Nielsen damping
entries.expected_product_impact: large-view optimisation converges; 96 views 2.5 s vs dense 13.7 s on the reproduced case

entries.existing_limitation: dense and sparse reported different covariances (SciPy robust Jacobian vs IRLS)
entries.proposed_implementation: single covariance definition (J^T W J)^-1 for both solvers

entries.existing_limitation: no visibility into solver termination
entries.proposed_implementation: per-round diagnostics (status, message, nfev, optimality, cost) returned in the result and job facts
entries.expected_product_impact: failures are visible, never silently retried

entries.existing_limitation: dense Jacobian built by finite differences
entries.proposed_implementation: analytic dense and sparse Jacobians
entries.expected_product_impact: 64 images 24 s to 9.5 s (before the association cache)

entries.existing_limitation: association refit dominated 90% of runtime at 48 images
entries.proposed_implementation: memoise cluster fits by evidence-id key, local to one call
entries.expected_product_impact: 48 views 3.3 s to 0.54 s; 87% hit rate; bitwise-identical to uncached

entries.existing_limitation: auto solver chose by view count only
entries.proposed_implementation: auto = dense up to 16 images, sparse above; chosen solver reported

entries.existing_limitation: 71 of 85 established walls changed id when one image was added (ids hash the evidence set)
entries.proposed_implementation: geometric identity carry-over across versions (Hungarian assignment, same type and storey)
entries.expected_product_impact: stable references for UI and annotations across incremental ingestion

entries.existing_limitation: no record of why an id was or was not kept
entries.proposed_implementation: identity decisions carried / ambiguous / merge / split_inherits / split / new / lost with costs and runner-up; per-id history across versions

entries.existing_limitation: producer and consumer states were not distinguished
entries.proposed_implementation: structured codes: BAD_SCHEMA, NON_FINITE, FRAME_MISMATCH, NO_POSE_FOR_FRAME, DUPLICATE_EVIDENCE_ID, SCALE_NOT_METRIC, NO_EVIDENCE, INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATIONS, unchanged
entries.expected_product_impact: actionable errors instead of silent skips

entries.existing_limitation: spatial optimisation not reachable from the job path
entries.proposed_implementation: optional stage spatial_global in non-default profile interior_survey_spatial behind RE_SPATIAL_GLOBAL; facts in job.payload
entries.expected_product_impact: job path executes the optimizer when a producer supplies inputs
entries.evidence_behaviour_changed: tests/test_spatial_global_stage.py (real API jobs, flag on and off)

entries.existing_limitation: entities carried no explicit frame or scale
entries.proposed_implementation: every compiled entity has coordinate_frame and scale_state; an unstated scale is 'unspecified', never metric

entries.existing_limitation: one aggregate would hide weaknesses
entries.proposed_implementation: five separate axes (geometric, structural, evidence, topological, processing) and per-stage timings in job facts

entries.existing_limitation: no way to inspect a spatial reconstruction
entries.proposed_implementation: read-only routes: versions, latest, version, entity (evidence resolved to raw image-frame measurements and poses), changes, export; tenant-scoped
entries.expected_product_impact: evidence, provenance and change inspection through the product API

entries.existing_limitation: taxonomy covered splits, merges and opening errors only
entries.proposed_implementation: 20-category taxonomy with per-failure ids, residuals, outlier score, root cause, severity, resolution, excluded/tentative flags; reprocessing identity probe

entries.existing_limitation: 12 of 84 runs had association failures
entries.proposed_implementation: lever-arm offset gate, no angle gate for openings, 3.5-sigma gates: reduced to 1 of 84 (a tentative single-view fragment)
entries.expected_product_impact: fewer split walls and false openings

entries.existing_limitation: only a rigid frame graph, no scale
entries.proposed_implementation: Sim3 + FrameRegistry with provenance, loop and scale consistency, invalid-transform refusal

entries.existing_limitation: no distinction between invalid, incomplete and uncertain
entries.proposed_implementation: five global states plus flags, wall components
entries.expected_product_impact: a missing wall is incomplete, not contradictory

entries.existing_limitation: no producer of spatial_inputs.v1 exists on any branch (all agent branches scanned)
entries.proposed_implementation: Gemini producer plus an end-to-end consumer test with real perception output
entries.expected_product_impact: the stage runs on real images; today it is skipped without a producer

entries.existing_limitation: corrections were not persisted or applied to the spatial world
entries.proposed_implementation: POST/GET /corrections: dimension and reclassify reuse world_ir.corrections and are replayed by the stage onto the next run; exclusions drop evidence before optimisation, keep the originals in the record, and change the input hash
entries.expected_product_impact: user corrections survive reprocessing and identity carry-over; wrong evidence can be removed without losing it

entries.existing_limitation: no frontend for spatial inspection
entries.proposed_implementation: Studio panel: evidence trail, uncertainty and conflict overlay, identity change review, frame and scale badge, completeness by region
entries.expected_product_impact: users can see and review the reconstruction

entries.existing_limitation: every run re-associates and re-optimises the whole world
entries.proposed_implementation: dirty-region detection from changed evidence ids; re-optimise the affected subgraph; cached-vs-uncached parity gate
entries.expected_product_impact: incremental cost proportional to the change

entries.existing_limitation: no dependency graph image to observation to entity to geometry
entries.proposed_implementation: persist the dependency graph in the world; change-impact queries

entries.existing_limitation: no undo for reconstruction changes
entries.proposed_implementation: version-diff revert as a new child version

entries.existing_limitation: interrupted jobs restart from scratch
entries.proposed_implementation: checkpoint optimiser state per round in the job store

entries.existing_limitation: no Schur-complement elimination
entries.proposed_implementation: eliminate wall-line parameters analytically for more than 500 images
dependencies: Ceres or GTSAM only if a measured need appears

entries.existing_limitation: no degeneracy detection beyond observed_dims
entries.proposed_implementation: rank and condition test on J^T W J with named degenerate directions

entries.existing_limitation: camera poses and scale are optimised in plan view only
entries.proposed_implementation: extend to SE(3) plus scale behind a metric-evidence gate

entries.existing_limitation: no loop closure or drift correction
entries.proposed_implementation: pose-graph closure from repeated structure with an ambiguity test

entries.existing_limitation: sparse LM budget is a fixed 3x TRF budget
entries.proposed_implementation: adaptive termination from residual decrease and conditioning

entries.existing_limitation: missing-boundary and repair proposals are not generated
entries.proposed_implementation: emit traceable repair proposals (never auto-applied) for open boundaries

entries.existing_limitation: stairs and storey connectivity only by z extent
entries.proposed_implementation: explicit vertical-connectivity graph with landing evidence

entries.existing_limitation: curved walls, sloped surfaces and uneven floors are not modelled
entries.proposed_implementation: parametric curved and sloped primitives with a model-selection gate

entries.existing_limitation: wall thickness is only seen through conflicts
entries.proposed_implementation: thickness from opposing-face pairs with evidence

entries.existing_limitation: floors and ceilings are not reconstructed as planes
entries.proposed_implementation: floor and ceiling plane estimation from points and per-storey height consistency

entries.existing_limitation: columns, beams and railings are not reconstructed
entries.proposed_implementation: new Kinds routed through the same association and constraint path

entries.existing_limitation: heavy occlusion leaves lower-bound extents (357 occlusion records)
entries.proposed_implementation: use cross-view evidence to resolve ends; never extrapolate unobserved geometry

entries.existing_limitation: relative-depth inputs produce 543 topology and 161 association failures
entries.proposed_implementation: scale-aware gates (sigma about 25% of range) and refusal below a precision floor
entries.expected_product_impact: no fake precision from relative depth

entries.existing_limitation: outlier fragments cause 112 over-segmentations
entries.proposed_implementation: robust re-association pass attaching fragments to a wall when pose-explained

entries.existing_limitation: a bad camera pose still leaves 0.168 m translation error
entries.proposed_implementation: per-image robust pose reweighting and pose-outlier flagging

entries.existing_limitation: calibration verified only on simulated data
entries.proposed_implementation: calibration set from surveyed rooms with real images once a producer exists

entries.existing_limitation: end-point sigma is overconfident in the tails (31/77/96 vs 39/86/99)
entries.proposed_implementation: inflation factor fitted on a development split and validated on evaluation seeds

entries.existing_limitation: competing hypotheses are stored as alternatives only for position conflicts
entries.proposed_implementation: first-class hypothesis sets with evidence masses for class and attachment

entries.existing_limitation: user corrections have a model in world_ir.corrections but the spatial world did not use it
entries.proposed_implementation: stage declares metric scale in world.metadata.scale (needed for VERIFIED dimensions) and replays user_corrections and user_decisions from the parent version
entries.expected_product_impact: human corrections outrank automatic results in the spatial world

entries.existing_limitation: split and merge decisions by the user are not offered through the spatial API
entries.proposed_implementation: route for split/merge using world_ir.corrections.split_entity/merge_entities

entries.existing_limitation: no deterministic snapshot format beyond to_dict
entries.proposed_implementation: canonical sorted snapshot plus content hash exposed by the export route

entries.existing_limitation: the default profile does not include the stage
entries.proposed_implementation: enable only after a real producer, regression benchmarks and a written safety assessment

entries.existing_limitation: progress and cancellation are not wired for the stage
entries.proposed_implementation: emit per-round progress and honour cancel between rounds

entries.existing_limitation: topology and constraints are O(n^2) over walls
entries.proposed_implementation: spatial index (cKDTree) for pair candidates above about 500 walls

entries.existing_limitation: no parallel association across storeys
entries.proposed_implementation: process independent storeys in parallel

entries.existing_limitation: 5 baseline failures (3 in stage_ladder, 2 in stage_layout) reproduced on 7aa752e7
entries.proposed_implementation: root cause: the scene gate classifies the fixture photos as outdoor so layout is skipped; fix the fixtures or pin the gate (perception-owned)
